notes: «فِي نَوَادِرِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ» names the author of a cited book: needs_ruling (rule 11); Muhammad b. Abi Umayr is not added (rule 6).
«أَنَّ اَلصَّادِقَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ» : the Imam named in the words after the chain is the last link (owner ruling 2), surface as named, blessing excluded.
The long supplication is the saying; it has no further transmitter.
